title: Tempeh with kale and potatoes
summary: Tempeh with kale and potatoes is a british dinner built around tempeh and kale, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Tempeh with kale and potatoes into even pieces and toss kale with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of kale while you season tempeh. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle tempeh and new potatoes among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Tempeh with kale and potatoes before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Tempeh with kale and potatoes into warm bowls with the juices.  Check that the potatoes is tender, then serve.
